_comment: Custom nodes baked into the packaged ComfyUI at build time by scripts/prepare-comfyui.ps1. Add a node by appending to `nodes`. Each node is git-cloned into ComfyUI/custom_nodes/<name> and its requirements.txt (if any) is installed into the bundled embedded Python. `ref` optionally pins a tag/branch/commit. `pip` lists extra packages to install globally into the bundled Python.

nodes.name: comfyui-modal
nodes.note: Cloud GPU offload via Modal (first provider).

nodes.name: ComfyUI-Workflow-Models-Downloader
nodes.note: Auto-detects the models a loaded workflow needs and downloads missing ones from HuggingFace/CivitAI/Manager DB into the correct folder (honors extra_model_paths). HTTP API at /workflow-models/* — we trigger a scan on workflow load.
